newsitem.title: ITALY: Ministry says collision caused Albanian shipwreck.
newsitem.headline: Ministry says collision caused Albanian shipwreck.

text.p: At least four people drowned on Friday when a boat full of Albanian refugees capsized and sank in the Adriatic sea after colliding with an Italian navy ship, the defence ministry said.

A ministry statement said the small Albanian coastal patrol boat, with some 30 civilians on deck and an unspecified number of people below, had collided with the corvette Sibilla, which had been trying to prevent it from entering Italian waters.
The statement said 34 people were rescued, two of whom had been injured. Four bodies were recovered.
The ministry said the Albanian boat had refused to obey orders from an Italian navy ship, which was applying a recent Albanian-Italian accord to dissuade Albanian boats from reaching Italy.
The collision occurred about 1800 GMT after the Albanian boat tried to block the path of the Italian boat. The Albanian boat sank some 35 miles off Brindisi about an hour later, the ministry said.
Coastguard and finance police officials in Brindisi involved in the rescue said it was not clear exactly how many people were on board. Estimates by rescued refugees ranged from 40 to 100.
